title: Home
description: Free, long-term, family-centered support for Jewish families facing serious illness in Baltimore and beyond.

header.heading: When serious illness strikes, the entire family is affected.
header.lead: Our programs, activities, and services are designed to help each family member. Always free. Always with dignity.

blocks.heading: How we help
blocks.intro: Every service is free, and shaped around what each family needs.

items.title: Care & counseling
items.text: Nursing care, hospital visits, and individual, group and bereavement counseling.

items.title: Family support
items.text: Meals and Shabbos packages, cleaning and laundry, babysitting, tutoring and camp.

items.title: Tikva House
items.text: Seven private suites with kosher hospitality, a block from Johns Hopkins Hospital.

blocks.heading: Your kindness becomes a meal, a night’s rest, a moment of normal
blocks.text: Every gift reaches a family facing serious illness — through meals, care, respite or a home at Tikva House.

blocks.heading: Facing a diagnosis? You don’t have to do this alone.
blocks.text: Reach out confidentially. We’re here for your whole family.
